meta.title: Hyderabad Atlas
sources: Circle lists: Siasat / Telangana Today, Feb 2026
Borders approximate: generated from locality positions

corporations.name: GHMC
corporations.fact: The historic core plus the south: Old City, Banjara Hills, Secunderabad and the airport belt. 30 circles, 150 wards.

corporations.name: Cyberabad
corporations.fact: The IT west and industrial north-west: HITEC City, Gachibowli, Kukatpally, Miyapur and Patancheru. 16 circles, 76 wards.

corporations.name: Malkajgiri
corporations.fact: The whole east: Alwal and Malkajgiri in the north-east down to Uppal, LB Nagar and Hayathnagar. 14 circles, 74 wards.

zones.name: Shamshabad
zones.fact: The southern airport belt: Shamshabad, Adibatla's aerospace SEZ and fast-growing suburbs along the ORR.

zones.name: Rajendranagar
zones.fact: South-west of the Old City: agricultural university campus, the zoo and dense neighbourhoods like Falaknuma and Chandrayangutta.

zones.name: Charminar
zones.fact: The 1591 heart of the city: Charminar, Laad Bazaar, Malakpet and Saidabad.

zones.name: Golconda
zones.fact: From Golconda Fort to Abids and Nampally: the Qutb Shahi west and the old commercial centre.

zones.name: Khairatabad
zones.fact: The city's upscale centre: Banjara Hills, Jubilee Hills, Panjagutta and Ameerpet.

zones.name: Secunderabad
zones.fact: North-central belt around the twin city: Musheerabad, Amberpet, Tarnaka and Osmania University.

zones.name: Serilingampally
zones.fact: The tech frontier: Gachibowli, Financial District, Kokapet, Miyapur and Patancheru.

zones.name: Kukatpally
zones.fact: HITEC City and Madhapur plus the huge KPHB and Kukatpally residential belt.

zones.name: Qutbullapur
zones.fact: Industrial north: Jeedimetla, Kompally, Nizampet, Dundigal and Medchal.

zones.name: LB Nagar
zones.fact: South-east gateway on the Vijayawada highway: LB Nagar, Dilsukhnagar, Vanasthalipuram, Hayathnagar.

zones.name: Malkajgiri
zones.fact: North-east residential belt: Malkajgiri, Alwal, Bowenpally, Moula Ali and Keesara.

zones.name: Uppal
zones.fact: Eastern growth corridor: Uppal stadium, Habsiguda, ECIL, Boduppal and Ghatkesar.

circles.name: Adibatla
circles.fact: Aerospace and defence SEZ (Tata, Lockheed parts) right on the ORR.

circles.name: Badangpet
circles.fact: Fast-growing south-east suburbs around Meerpet lake and Nadergul airfield.

circles.name: Jalpally
circles.fact: Pahadi Shareef dargah hill and the Balapur belt south of the Old City.

circles.name: Shamshabad
circles.fact: Home of Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (RGIA).

circles.name: Rajendranagar
circles.fact: PJTSAU agricultural university campus and the Himayat Sagar side.

circles.name: Attapur
circles.fact: Along the PVNR Expressway pillars; a busy residential hub on the way to the airport.

circles.name: Bahadurpura
circles.fact: Nehru Zoological Park and the old Kishan Bagh area.

circles.name: Falaknuma
circles.fact: Falaknuma Palace on its hill, now a Taj hotel.

circles.name: Chandrayangutta
circles.fact: Junction of the Inner Ring Road and the Srisailam highway; Barkas is famous for its Arab heritage.

circles.name: Jangammet
circles.fact: Lal Darwaza's Mahankali temple and the Bonalu festival lanes.

circles.name: Santosh Nagar
circles.fact: Saidabad and Santosh Nagar: dense residential south-east of the Old City.

circles.name: Yakutpura
circles.fact: One of the oldest Old City neighbourhoods, close to the Musi's south bank.

circles.name: Malakpet
circles.fact: Malakpet race course and the Nalgonda X-roads junction.

circles.name: Charminar
circles.fact: Charminar (1591), Mecca Masjid, Laad Bazaar and Chowmahalla Palace.

circles.name: Moosarambagh
circles.fact: On the Musi's east bank with the Moosarambagh bridge and metro stop.

circles.name: Goshamahal
circles.fact: Begum Bazaar wholesale market, Abids, Koti and Osmania Hospital.

circles.name: Karwan
circles.fact: Dhoolpet and Purana Pul, the city's oldest bridge (1578) over the Musi.

circles.name: Golconda
circles.fact: Golconda Fort and the Qutb Shahi Tombs.

circles.name: Mehdipatnam
circles.fact: Major bus hub where the PVNR Expressway begins.

circles.name: Masab Tank
circles.fact: Nampally station, the state Assembly and Red Hills.

circles.name: Khairatabad
circles.fact: Khairatabad Ganesh, Hussain Sagar's west shore, Banjara Hills and Panjagutta.

circles.name: Jubilee Hills
circles.fact: Upscale villas, Film Nagar studios and KBR National Park.

circles.name: Borabanda
circles.fact: Hill-side neighbourhood near Erragadda and the MMTS line.

circles.name: Yousufguda
circles.fact: Krishna Nagar's film-industry lanes and Srinagar Colony.

circles.name: Ameerpet
circles.fact: Coaching-centre capital and the Red/Blue metro interchange.

circles.name: Kavadiguda
circles.fact: Lower Tank Bund, Indira Park and Gandhi Nagar on Hussain Sagar's east side.

circles.name: Musheerabad
circles.fact: RTC X Roads cinemas, Chikkadpally and Himayatnagar.

circles.name: Amberpet
circles.fact: Kacheguda station, Barkatpura and Nallakunta.

circles.name: Tarnaka
circles.fact: Osmania University's arts college and the Tarnaka metro junction.

circles.name: Mettuguda
circles.fact: Right beside Secunderabad railway station: Chilkalguda and Sitaphalmandi.

circles.name: Narsingi
circles.fact: Kokapet's skyscrapers, Neopolis and Manikonda on the ORR.

circles.name: Patancheru
circles.fact: Industrial town with BHEL, ICRISAT and the Mumbai highway (NH65).

circles.name: Ameenpur
circles.fact: Ameenpur Lake (a biodiversity heritage site) and Beeramguda.

circles.name: Miyapur
circles.fact: Red Line terminus; Chandanagar and Hafeezpet.

circles.name: Serilingampally
circles.fact: Gachibowli, Financial District, University of Hyderabad and Tellapur.

circles.name: Madhapur
circles.fact: HITEC City, Cyber Towers, Durgam Cheruvu cable bridge and Kondapur.

circles.name: Allwyn Colony
circles.fact: Former Allwyn factory township, now a dense residential area.

circles.name: Kukatpally
circles.fact: KPHB, one of Asia's largest housing colonies, and JNTU.

circles.name: Moosapet
circles.fact: Balanagar industrial area and the Y-junction on the Bombay highway.

circles.name: Chintal
circles.fact: IDPL township and the Qutbullapur industrial lanes.

circles.name: Jeedimetla
circles.fact: One of the state's largest industrial estates.

circles.name: Kompally
circles.fact: Suchitra junction and the NH44 corridor north towards Medchal.

circles.name: Gajularamaram
circles.fact: Hill-side settlements around Jagadgirigutta.

circles.name: Nizampet
circles.fact: Bachupally's apartment boom and Pragathi Nagar's lake.

circles.name: Dundigal
circles.fact: Air Force Academy, Dundigal; the north-west ORR edge.

circles.name: Medchal
circles.fact: The northern gateway on NH44 towards Nagpur.

circles.name: Nagole
circles.fact: Blue Line terminus and the Musi crossing towards Uppal.

circles.name: Saroornagar
circles.fact: Dilsukhnagar's shopping streets, Kothapet fruit market and Saroornagar lake.

circles.name: LB Nagar
circles.fact: Red Line terminus at the Vijayawada highway (NH65) junction.

circles.name: Hayathnagar
circles.fact: Edge of the city towards Ramoji Film City on NH65.

circles.name: Keesara
circles.fact: Jawaharnagar, Dammaiguda and Nagaram on the north-east edge; Keesaragutta temple nearby.

circles.name: Alwal
circles.fact: Old Alwal, Lothkunta and the Bolarum side of the cantonment.

circles.name: Bowenpally
circles.fact: Bowenpally vegetable market and Tadbund on the Begumpet side.

circles.name: Moula Ali
circles.fact: Moula Ali dargah on its rocky hill and the HB Colony belt.

circles.name: Malkajgiri
circles.fact: Old railway town with Neredmet, Safilguda lake and Anand Bagh.

circles.name: Boduppal
circles.fact: Peerzadiguda and Medipally along the Warangal highway.

circles.name: Ghatkesar
circles.fact: Eastern ORR town on the Warangal highway (NH163).

circles.name: Kapra
circles.fact: ECIL, AS Rao Nagar and Sainikpuri; Cherlapally railway terminal.

circles.name: Nacharam
circles.fact: Nacharam industrial area, Mallapur and Habsiguda.

circles.name: Uppal
circles.fact: Uppal cricket stadium and the elevated corridor junction.

landmarks.name: Charminar
landmarks.fact: Built in 1591 by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah; the city grew out from here.

landmarks.name: Mecca Masjid
landmarks.fact: One of India's largest mosques; bricks made with soil from Mecca, legend says.

landmarks.name: Laad Bazaar
landmarks.fact: Bangle and pearl street running west from Charminar.

landmarks.name: Chowmahalla Palace
landmarks.fact: Seat of the Asaf Jahi Nizams; four palaces around a courtyard.

landmarks.name: Falaknuma Palace
landmarks.fact: 'Mirror of the sky', 1893 palace on a hill, now a Taj hotel.

landmarks.name: Salar Jung Museum
landmarks.fact: One of India's largest one-man art collections, on the Musi's bank.

landmarks.name: Purani Haveli
landmarks.fact: The Nizam's museum: one of the longest wardrobes in the world.

landmarks.name: Golconda Fort
landmarks.fact: Qutb Shahi citadel famous for its acoustics and the diamond trade.

landmarks.name: Qutb Shahi Tombs
landmarks.fact: Garden necropolis of the seven Qutb Shahi kings.

landmarks.name: Taramati Baradari
landmarks.fact: Hilltop pavilion linked to the legend of singer Taramati.

landmarks.name: Hussain Sagar
landmarks.fact: Heart-shaped lake built in 1562 that links Hyderabad and Secunderabad.

landmarks.name: Buddha Statue
landmarks.fact: 18 m monolith on the Rock of Gibraltar island in Hussain Sagar.

landmarks.name: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Statue
landmarks.fact: 125 ft statue beside the new Secretariat, unveiled in 2023.

landmarks.name: Telangana Martyrs Memorial
landmarks.fact: Steel 'eternal flame' memorial on the Hussain Sagar shore.

landmarks.name: Birla Mandir
landmarks.fact: White marble Venkateswara temple on Naubath Pahad.

landmarks.name: NTR Gardens
landmarks.fact: Lakeside park beside the Ambedkar statue and Secretariat.

landmarks.name: Lumbini Park
landmarks.fact: Boat jetty to the Buddha statue and the laser show.

landmarks.name: Public Gardens
landmarks.fact: Bagh-e-Aam (1846) with the State Museum and Assembly.

landmarks.name: Nehru Zoological Park
landmarks.fact: 380-acre zoo next to Mir Alam Tank.

landmarks.name: KBR National Park
landmarks.fact: Forest in the middle of Jubilee Hills; peacocks and joggers.

landmarks.name: Durgam Cheruvu
landmarks.fact: The 'secret lake' with Hyderabad's cable-stayed bridge.

landmarks.name: Shilparamam
landmarks.fact: Arts and crafts village beside HITEC City.

landmarks.name: Cyber Towers
landmarks.fact: 1998 building that started HITEC City.

landmarks.name: Osmania University
landmarks.fact: 1918 university; the Arts College is its icon.

landmarks.name: Indian School of Business
landmarks.fact: ISB's Gachibowli campus, a global B-school.

landmarks.name: University of Hyderabad
landmarks.fact: Central university with rocky, lake-filled grounds.

landmarks.name: Rajiv Gandhi Intl. Cricket Stadium
landmarks.fact: Uppal stadium, home of Sunrisers Hyderabad.

landmarks.name: Moula Ali Dargah
landmarks.fact: Hilltop shrine reached by about 500 steps.

landmarks.name: Paigah Tombs
landmarks.fact: Marble-lattice tombs of the Paigah nobles.

landmarks.name: Secunderabad Junction
landmarks.fact: South Central Railway's headquarters station.

landmarks.name: Nampally (Hyderabad Deccan)
landmarks.fact: The original Hyderabad railway station.

landmarks.name: Kacheguda Station
landmarks.fact: 1916 Gothic-style station building.

landmarks.name: Charlapalli Terminal
landmarks.fact: New satellite rail terminal opened in 2025.

landmarks.name: MGBS Bus Station
landmarks.fact: Mahatma Gandhi Bus Station, one of Asia's largest bus stations.

landmarks.name: JBS Bus Station
landmarks.fact: Jubilee Bus Station, Secunderabad's bus hub.

landmarks.name: Rajiv Gandhi Intl. Airport
landmarks.fact: RGIA at Shamshabad, opened in 2008.

landmarks.name: Begumpet Airport
landmarks.fact: The old airport, now for VIP flights and Wings India.

landmarks.name: Osman Sagar (Gandipet)
landmarks.fact: 1920 reservoir built after the 1908 Musi flood.

landmarks.name: Himayat Sagar
landmarks.fact: Twin reservoir of Osman Sagar on the Esi river.

landmarks.name: Mir Alam Tank
landmarks.fact: 1806 lake with a multi-arched dam, beside the zoo.

landmarks.name: Ameenpur Lake
landmarks.fact: India's first water body declared a Biodiversity Heritage Site.

landmarks.name: Fox Sagar
landmarks.fact: Kompally's large lake (Kotha Cheruvu).

landmarks.name: Shamirpet Lake
landmarks.fact: Picnic lake just beyond the ORR on the Karimnagar road.

landmarks.name: Mahavir Harina Vanasthali
landmarks.fact: Deer park in Vanasthalipuram.

landmarks.name: Clock Tower Secunderabad
landmarks.fact: 1897 clock tower in Secunderabad.

landmarks.name: Chilkur Balaji Temple
landmarks.fact: The 'visa Balaji' temple near Osman Sagar.

landmarks.name: Spanish Mosque
landmarks.fact: Moorish-style 1906 mosque at Begumpet.

landmarks.name: Ramoji Film City
landmarks.fact: One of the world's largest film studio complexes, past Hayathnagar.

corridors.name: NH65 west (Mumbai Hwy)
corridors.desc: The old Bombay highway from Ameerpet out to Patancheru

corridors.name: Airport Road
corridors.desc: Mehdipatnam over the PVNR Expressway to RGIA

corridors.name: IT Corridor
corridors.desc: Panjagutta west to the Financial District
